name: Break Into Flareon's House and Date Him??
source:
"Break Into Flareon's House and Date Him??" is a meme game where you repeatedly get thrown out of Flareon's house for home invasion. What combination of dialogue options will win your way into his heart? What stupid jokes and unnecessary lore will you find along the way?

[From [url=https://archerzenmi.itch.io/break-into-flareons-house-and-date-him]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“闯入弗拉里昂的房子并和他约会？”是一款模因游戏，你会因为入室盗窃而多次被赶出Flareon的房子。什么样的对话选项组合才能赢得你的心？一路上你会发现哪些愚蠢的笑话和不必要的传说？

[来自[url=https://archerzenmi.itch.io/break-into-flareons-house-and-date-him]Itch.io[/url]]
